# Nicolas Desjardins (webman.dev)

> Nicolas (Nick) Desjardins is an applied AI developer and senior full-stack developer in the Greater Montreal Area, Quebec, working in English and French. He builds AI that reads documents, answers from a company's own files with the source quoted, and keeps working when a provider fails, backed by 8+ years running production web systems for New Roots Herbal Inc. He is open to full-time roles, contracts and agency placements, hybrid in Montreal or remote across Canada and the US.

## What he can build for a company (plain language)

- Invoices, purchase orders and forms that are still retyped by hand: document data extraction with a validated schema and model fallback. Proof: 21 of 21 test invoices fully correct on the 7 October 2026 benchmark.
- Staff who cannot find answers in procedures and regulatory manuals: hybrid retrieval (RAG) that quotes the exact passage and page, and says so when the documents do not cover the question. Proof: 6 of 6 recorded questions answered with verified quotes, 1 of 1 out-of-scope question declined (14 October 2026).
- Multi-step back-office work where a person must approve the risky steps: supervised AI agents (LangGraph). Planned; its figures are targets.
- Knowing whether answers got worse after a change: evaluation in CI, tracing and caching (LLMOps). Planned; its figures are targets.
- Websites and online stores that must not go down when servers change: 30+ websites migrated with zero downtime at New Roots Herbal Inc.
- A website a team can edit itself and AI tools can operate safely: NextBlock CMS, an AI-native CMS with an MCP server.

## Flagship product: NextBlock CMS

- [NextBlock CMS](https://nextblock.dev): the open-source, full-stack AI-native CMS for Next.js 16, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS. Nicolas Desjardins is its creator, designer, and lead developer.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/nextblock-cms/nextblock): Nx monorepo.
- [Live sandbox](https://cms.nextblock.dev/): demo@nextblock.dev / password, resets every 15 minutes.
- Install: npm create nextblock@latest
- Scale (October 2026): 200k+ lines of TypeScript; 8 npm packages at v0.21.3 (create-nextblock and @nextblock-cms/ui, utils, db, editor, sdk, ecom, cortex); 191 CLI releases since October 2025; 11.5k CLI downloads in the 30 days to 7 October 2026; 620+ commits; 146 Vitest test files; 21 forward-only SQL migrations.
- Architecture: Nx monorepo. Every content block is a JSONB row in Supabase PostgreSQL under row-level security; data-driven custom block types render with no rebuild; Live Draft Mode and revisions; linked EN/FR translations; SEO graded as you type. Public routes are React Server Components.
- Cortex AI: the CMS is an MCP server (Streamable HTTP, scoped bearer tokens, 56 tools, confirmation-gated mutations) listed in the official MCP Registry as dev.nextblock/nextblock. OpenRouter routing through the Vercel AI SDK with free-model fallback. AES-256-GCM encrypted bring-your-own-key storage.
- Commerce Pro: Stripe for physical goods, Freemius for digital licensing, multi-currency with rounding modes, scheduled sales, shipping zones, taxes, inventory, orders.
- Distribution: one-click Vercel deploy with zero environment variables (Supabase provisioned and keys injected before the first build), self-hosted Docker stack (Postgres, GoTrue, PostgREST, Kong, MinIO), npm run update applied as a git three-way merge.
- Performance: 100/100 Lighthouse in all four categories on the production build (0.3 s FCP, 0.8 s LCP, 0 ms TBT, 0 CLS).

## Projects

- [Invoice Extraction Service, live documentation](https://nickdesjardins.github.io/Invoice-Extraction-Service/): Phase 1, Production Live & Open Source. An asynchronous FastAPI microservice that turns messy, unstructured documents into a guaranteed, schema-validated invoice record. Resilience comes from routing across models, not vendors: a free primary model cascades to a second provider on rate limits, timeouts, or schema exceptions, at zero marginal cost.
- [Invoice Extraction Service, source on GitHub](https://github.com/nickdesjardins/Invoice-Extraction-Service): FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, Docker.
- Context-Aware Hybrid Compliance Retrieval Engine (Phase 2, In Active Pipeline, Delivery: Days 31 to 60): A retrieval engine for regulatory documents, SOPs, and product dossiers that answers with paragraph-level citations instead of plausible guesses. Dense and sparse retrieval run in parallel inside PostgreSQL, candidates are fused, then compressed to a handful of high-confidence passages by a cross-encoder.
- Autonomous Multi-Agent Operations Pipeline (Phase 3, In Active Pipeline, Delivery: Days 61 to 90): A cyclic LangGraph workflow that coordinates SQL inventory queries, channel-specific copy synthesis, and regulatory compliance auditing. Validation failures loop back with structured revision notes. High-risk mutations pause for a human before anything leaves the system.
- Production LLMOps Gateway & Evaluation CI/CD Suite (Phase 4, In Active Pipeline, Delivery: Days 91 to 120): An enterprise reverse proxy in front of every model call. Semantically similar queries resolve from a Redis vector cache in milliseconds, every transaction is traced, and a CI pipeline runs regression evaluations against golden datasets so a bad prompt change never reaches main.

## Production web work

- [newrootsherbal.com](https://newrootsherbal.com/): employer work for New Roots Herbal Inc. Full platform revamp on Laravel 13, a custom PHP CMS and e-commerce store written from scratch, with a Google Maps store locator and a real-time inventory system.
- Eighteen campaign and education microsites for New Roots Herbal product lines (employer work): standalone Next.js sites such as [vitamins.newrootsherbal.com](https://vitamins.newrootsherbal.com/), [probiotics.newrootsherbal.com](https://probiotics.newrootsherbal.com/), [coughandcold.ca](https://www.coughandcold.ca/) and [prostateperform.ca](https://prostateperform.ca/), plus Laravel-served pages such as [newrootsherbal.com/cardiac-health](https://newrootsherbal.com/cardiac-health).
- [MusiqueSD](https://www.musiquesd.com/): independent client site. Bilingual FR/EN marketing site for a Montreal recording studio, DJ and event animation business.
- [Ryūgū: Ten Nights to the Dragon Palace](https://japan.webman.dev/): independent. A chaptered travel companion for an eleven-day voyage around Japan and Jeju.
- [Thieves' Cant Translator](https://www.thethievescant.com/): independent. A D&D 5e rogue's companion that translates English or French into Thieves' Cant, with a dictionary, symbols and hobo signs.
- [pcsquad.ca](https://pcsquad.ca/): own business, founded 2012. The bilingual site of Nicolas's first company, a computer repair and website shop he owned and ran from 2012 to 2018.
- [Civalgo Punch](https://civalgo-punch.vercel.app/): experiment kept online for show. A real-time worker check-in system.
- [React Hooks Guide](https://react-hooks-delta-umber.vercel.app/): experiment kept online for show. An interactive guide to React hooks.

- Lead Web Developer & Applied AI Integration, New Roots Herbal Inc., Vaudreuil-Dorion, QC (Nov 2018 to Present): Own production reliability, data architecture, and infrastructure across the company's digital estate, and lead the integration of generative AI into day-to-day operations.
- Technical Founder, PcSquad, Les Coteaux, QC (2012 to 2018): Founded and operated a regional IT solutions and web infrastructure consultancy.

Education: Computer Science, General Program, Concordia University, Montreal (2016 to 2018); DEC in Computer Science, John Abbott College, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue (2009 to 2012).
